name: 上板橋駅東第2の自転車駐車場を追加
summary: 区営自転車駐車場の一覧に、上板橋駅東第2自転車駐車場を加え、2026年11月1日から施行します。上板橋駅西の定期利用者は、一定の場合に東第2の利用承認を受けたものと扱われ、残り期間の利用料金は不要です。更新時の料金や、みなし承認の終了後の扱いも定めます。
changes: 別表に上板橋駅東第2自転車駐車場（東京都板橋区常盤台四丁目21番）を加える
上板橋駅西の定期利用承認を東第2の承認とみなし、残り期間の利用料金を不要とする
更新申請で上板橋駅西の定期利用承認を受けた場合、東第2の承認とみなし、西駐車場の料金額を適用する
みなし承認の効力が終わる日に残存期間がある場合、西駐車場の承認とみなし、その期間の利用料金を不要とする
who: 上板橋駅東第2自転車駐車場を利用する人
上板橋駅西自転車駐車場の定期利用者
why: 区営自転車駐車場1か所を新設する必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds the Kamitabashi Station East No. 2 bicycle parking lot
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Development of Bicycle Parking Lots and Prevention of Bicycle Abandonment
en.summary: The Kamitabashi Station East No. 2 Bicycle Parking Lot will be added to the list of ward-operated bicycle parking lots, and the ordinance will take effect on November 1, 2026. In certain cases, people with regular-use approval for Kamitabashi Station West will be treated as having approval to use East No. 2, and will not have to pay fees for the remaining period. The ordinance also sets the fees for renewals and how cases will be handled after deemed approval ends.
changes: Add the Kamitabashi Station East No. 2 Bicycle Parking Lot (4-21 Tokiwadai, Itabashi City, Tokyo) to the attached table
Treat regular-use approval for Kamitabashi Station West as approval for East No. 2, and waive the fee for the remaining period
If regular-use approval for Kamitabashi Station West is granted through a renewal application, treat it as approval for East No. 2 and apply the fee for the West parking lot
If any period remains on the date deemed approval ends, treat it as approval for the West parking lot and waive the fee for that period
who: People using the Kamitabashi Station East No. 2 Bicycle Parking Lot
Regular users of the Kamitabashi Station West Bicycle Parking Lot
en.why: The ward says this is because one new ward-operated bicycle parking lot needs to be established.
